title: A Salt for the Thorn
author: D. M. Whitlock
blurb: Zephyrine Eriksen, a cartographer of unmapped realms, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
